protocol.basis_fit: one rank8 SVD basis per parameter seed from concatenated within-condition-centered training clouds; no heldout states or evidence labels
protocol.claim_boundary: label-free heldout geometry measurement only; no decoder recovery, evidence-code, causal channel, utility, learning or adaptation claim
protocol.corpus: all 64 binary base histories per order; targets independently balanced; A, B, all four C suffixes paired by history index; no resolution frame
protocol.coverage_condition: excluded fraction of centered source and target cloud variance <=0.01 in heldout conditions
protocol.descriptive_threshold: full-space heldout similarity residual <=0.1 of heldout A-cloud RMS at every seed/condition, conditional on adequate coverage; this is approximate geometry support only
protocol.evaluation: fresh heldout order; denominator fixed as heldout A-cloud RMS about its centroid for every map/condition; separate centroid and centered residuals plus in/out-of-subspace residuals
protocol.falsifier: large residual rejects this training-derived shared map; insufficient coverage or shared order-dependent residual offsets make a deformation conclusion inconclusive
protocol.independent_unit: model seed; histories and variants are dependent paired observations
protocol.similarity_fit: paired training histories only; proper orthogonal rotation, nonnegative uniform scale, full-space translation; unchanged source fluctuations outside basis. Means are stored explicitly and prediction equals mu_target + centered_source + (scale*projected_centered_source*rotation - projected_centered_source)*basis_transpose, retaining translation rather than deleting it

variants.00/01/10/11: same evidence plus corresponding two-symbol reliability-0.5 suffix plus 32 blanks
